verdict.headline: Easy for local prototyping, but restricted scopes require rigorous verification and CASA security assessments for public production.
verdict.timeToFirstConnection: 15–30 minutes to set up a dev client with test users.
verdict.timeToProduction: Several weeks or longer due to Google OAuth verification and CASA security assessment for restricted Gmail scopes.
verdict.handsOnEffort: Moderate setup for GCP project, but high effort for submitting review materials, recording demo videos, and completing security assessments.
verdict.cost: Free to register and test, though third-party security assessments may incur external costs depending on scope.
verdict.biggestRisk: 7-day refresh token expirations while unverified in testing mode, and potential rejection during CASA/OAuth verification for restricted Gmail scopes.

ownAppDecision.summary: Use Composio's managed app to start immediately without setup. Register your own OAuth app when you need custom branding, dedicated rate limits, or production-grade access to restricted Gmail scopes.
reasons: Composio lets you prototype immediately without setting up GCP credentials or consent screens.
Custom branding on the Google consent screen requires registering your own app.
Restricted Gmail API access in production requires your own verified GCP app and security assessment.

phases.name: Preparation & GCP Setup
phases.goal: Establish a Google Cloud Project and configure basic OAuth consent screen settings.

steps.title: Create a Google Cloud Project
steps.detail: Navigate to the Google Cloud Console and set up a new project to host your OAuth credentials.
steps.agentHelp: Guide user through GCP navigation and project naming parameters.

steps.title: Configure OAuth Consent Screen
steps.detail: Define user type (External or Internal) and enter developer support details and verified domains.
steps.agentHelp: Draft initial consent screen metadata and generate compliance checklists.

phases.name: App Building & Testing
phases.goal: Generate OAuth credentials and test API calls with allowlisted test users.

steps.title: Create Client Credentials
steps.detail: Select application type (e.g., Web application) and specify authorized redirect URIs.
steps.agentHelp: Validate redirect URI format according to Google's strict rules (no userinfo, valid TLDs).

steps.title: Add Test Users and Scopes
steps.detail: Add test user emails to allowlist and select required Gmail API scopes (e.g., gmail.readonly, gmail.send).
steps.agentHelp: Draft scope list and confirm non-overlapping scope permissions.

steps.title: Implement Authorization Flow
steps.detail: Integrate OAuth 2.0 PKCE auth code flow with offline access (`access_type=offline`) to receive refresh tokens.
steps.agentHelp: Generate full boilerplate code for Google OAuth authorization code exchange with PKCE.

phases.name: Verification & Go Live
phases.goal: Pass Google OAuth Verification and CASA Security Assessment for public deployment.

steps.title: Prepare Review Materials
steps.detail: Host an accessible privacy policy on your domain and record a demonstration video showing UI scope usage.
steps.agentHelp: Draft privacy policy language and review video scripts.

steps.title: Submit for OAuth Verification
steps.detail: Submit consent screen details and screencast through the Google Cloud Console OAuth Verification Center.
steps.agentHelp: Pre-fill scope justification descriptions for submission forms.

steps.title: Complete CASA Security Assessment
steps.detail: For restricted scopes storing server data, complete the Cloud App Security Assessment (CASA) evaluation.
steps.agentHelp: Review security questionnaire requirements against implementation details.

phases.name: Maintenance & Annual Compliance
phases.goal: Keep app compliant with annual security re-evaluations and credential maintenance.

steps.title: Annual Security Re-assessment
steps.detail: Re-verify restricted scope usage and renew CASA assessment every 12 months.
steps.agentHelp: Schedule automated reminders and track review deadline milestones.

steps.title: Monitor App Activity
steps.detail: Ensure client ID activity remains active to prevent automatic deletion after 6 months of inactivity.
steps.agentHelp: Periodically check API telemetry or automate dummy connection tests.

requirements.detail: A GCP project is mandatory to set up the OAuth consent screen and register client credentials.
Must be hosted on the same domain as the app's homepage and linked on the consent screen.
Required for sensitive and restricted scopes to show how data is used in the application UI.
Mandatory when storing/transmitting data obtained via restricted Gmail scopes on external servers.

permissions.name: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send
permissions.purpose: Allows an AI agent to compose and send emails on the user's behalf.
permissions.notes: Requires OAuth verification but skips the full CASA security assessment.

permissions.name: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly
permissions.purpose: Allows an AI agent to read email messages and settings.
permissions.notes: Requires OAuth verification and CASA security assessment if data is stored on servers.

permissions.name: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.metadata
permissions.purpose: Allows an AI agent to read headers and labels without reading email body content.
permissions.notes: Narrower alternative to full body access.

permissions.name: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify
permissions.purpose: Allows an AI agent to insert, update, and manage email content/labels.
permissions.notes: Triggers highest verification scrutiny due to full mailbox access.

nuances.title: 7-Day Refresh Token Expiration in Testing Mode
nuances.detail: While the OAuth app publish status is set to 'Testing', refresh tokens expire after 7 days, forcing frequent user re-authentication.

nuances.title: 6-Month Inactivity Deletion
nuances.detail: OAuth 2.0 client IDs that remain completely inactive for 6 months are automatically deleted by Google.

nuances.title: Unverified App Consent Warnings
nuances.detail: Users will see a prominent 'Unverified App' warning screen during consent until OAuth verification is fully passed.

blockers.symptom: User receives a 403 Forbidden error during OAuth flow.
blockers.howToProceed: Ensure the SDK or code requests the exact narrow scopes configured in the consent screen. Avoid automatic injection of broader scopes like gmail.modify.

blockers.symptom: Google returns a `redirect_uri_mismatch` error page during login.
blockers.howToProceed: Verify that the request URL matches the exact authorized redirect URI string configured in the Google Cloud Console.

agentCan: Generate backend code for OAuth 2.0 PKCE flow with Google.
Validate redirect URIs against Google Cloud syntax rules.
Draft rationale and scope justification text for verification forms.
Monitor refresh token activity to prevent 6-month inactivity expiration.
youMust: Create and manage the Google Cloud Project.
Record and submit the UI scope demonstration video.
Host the privacy policy on your application's domain.
Complete the CASA security assessment questionnaire and audit.
